how: Members invite helpers to draw the flag and repeatedly make success conditional on gathering enough hands
Manpower doubts coexist with offers to try rather than necessarily stopping construction
A participant asks what the canvas is and receives an explanation while another later asks how to draw
A bare contribution report receives bare thanks without a further request
Different participants propose the mark, begin its background and supply a template without requiring joining to define the starter role
Proposed Chinese wording and objections to HK letters show competing design preferences without establishing a collective reversal
Coordinates, a pixel template and a corner anchor make the proposed flag actionable
Participants report starting the red background and doing their part without measuring the placements
Members open a planning chat, repair invitations and relay cooperation and location reports back to the thread
A site-imposed commenting delay prompts a request for others to pass the plan along
Local sleep threatens the available workforce and overseas friends offer help across that gap
An open anchor request and a later reported decision leave procedures in the unseen chat unresolved
Reports of contribution and credit to chat helpers establish neither machine placement nor its absence
Opening a coordination chat and visiting a neighbour for permission do not establish covert planning or infiltration
Members call for defence and continued checking after establishment

The uninformed-repair explanation requires keepers to accept the proposed change, since explicit lettering objections establish competing preferences while actual overwriters' knowledge remains unknown
A participant attributes reclamation to the host group without independently identifying the placers
Capacity limits and neighbour conflict stop an optional extension while helpers may continue later or assist the neighbour
Stopping optional growth for conflict and insufficient people does not establish personal stress, individual withdrawal or repair of a personal quarrel
Builders scout viable locations and adjust a template around neighbouring work without an evidenced prior loss
Participants seek building space and later negotiate around a neighbouring logo move
Builders report permission to occupy host territory and select it for expected security before announcing completion
Reported permission supports guest entry but leaves promised protection and enforceable host authority unresolved
A participant carries permission from the host chat back to the flag builders
Seeking permission and anticipated security directs construction toward host territory before completion
Builders remove three template rows expressly to avoid overwriting neighbouring work
Participants thank neighbouring helpers without specifying a reciprocal exchange or their share of the labour
An alliance question receives confirmation of permission rather than mutual defence obligations or joint organisation
Missing the memo states a communication problem without an explicit disclaimer of standing, rejection of binding terms or refusal of an agreement
Time spent repairing another project establishes competing effort without establishing dual membership in rooms at this border or contest
Changed coordinates and redirected expansion do not establish relocation after the completed flag was erased or overrun
A participant condemns alleged reclamation as disrespect for rule of law without independently verifying the host's actions
A proposed political slogan gives a limited expression beyond the flag without explaining the whole effort through national history
Political wording and dislike of a letter do not identify an inherited quarrel carried into the canvas
The political slogan proposal supplies no pre-existing tie naming a rival as the reason to attack
Hoping the flag remains in one piece makes a local pun beside its connection to the neighbouring work
Objections to a letter's appearance do not establish a dispute about offensive language, slurs or hate symbols
Opening a flag chat establishes a venue but does not disclose whether a distinct room of followers and shared authority formed
Explaining the canvas as an April Fools game does not establish a prank or takeover in the host subreddit
Surviving call and placement titles do not disclose whether removed bodies reflected a canvas-posting rule
Disliking lettering does not establish vandalism motivated by opposition to canvas posts in the host subreddit
Participants announce establishment, congratulate helpers and thank contributions
A comment reports the flag still perfect after placement ended
A post-close survival report neither corrects an account nor contests or requests cleanup of a preserved version
The closing survival report and later explanation of missed participation establish no decision to continue the organisation or reuse its mark
Credit for outside help does not establish newcomers or returning members finding the subreddit through its image
A proposed political slogan does not establish outreach to a specified creator, organisation or press audience
A reported red column suggests encroachment but leaves its builders' relation to the room and any adopted attack plan unresolved
Requests for agreement and an invitation to help the neighbour do not establish taunting or victory claims in a rival-facing contest
A direct answer to the drawing call requests coordinates and reports starting the background
A mark proposal and recruitment may be the same utterance rather than separately ordered stages
The explicit transition from success to defending against mismatched dots ties upkeep to establishment
Negotiation can precede completion because builders seek permission for a secure construction site rather than only defending an established mark
Permission and template restraint share an exchange but avoiding neighbouring art is the stated reason rather than an evidenced treaty obligation
Visible defence calls leave placement methods unknown and cannot establish upkeep causing automation
A reported contribution receives direct thanks linking participation in building to recognition
Establishment celebrations and a later survival report show sequence without explaining celebration as the cause of recording
Closing passages reveal no continuation decision whose dependence on recording could be tested
Stopping optional growth does not test shortage causing relocation of an erased or overrun core
Templates coordinate provisional versions without necessarily settling later additions or lettering disputes
Accepting a call can request coordinates or explain manpower conditions rather than supplying a bare answer
Offers from overseas friends and thanks for neighbouring help do not establish upkeep shortage causing inter-room assistance
Permission followed by thanks for outside help leaves the terms of any reciprocal bargain unobserved
An extension invitation and a later column report leave unresolved whether recruitment produced an attack on a rival
An abort explained by conflict and limited manpower does not establish a refusal answering an attack call
Negotiation around expansion is visible but an attack causing that negotiation remains unresolved
An encroachment report and agreement request do not establish an attack followed by a continuing rival-facing contest
Expected security and credited help reveal no completed coalition agreement caused by maintenance pressure
Calls for helpers and surviving titles leave any causal chain through a canvas-posting flood and host regulation unresolved
Negotiation and missed communication do not establish an explicit statement limiting authority or a refusal of binding terms
